visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man (Peter) in a black t-shirt and a woman (Susan) in a blue striped dress argue on a sunny plaza with a colorful arch. Peter looks stressed, gesturing with his hands. (2) Peter tries to take a photo of Susan posing under the arch from a distance. (3) They look at the phone screen; Susan points at it with a disappointed expression, and Peter sighs. (4) Peter approaches a man (Paddy) in a white shirt and black cap. Paddy nods while holding a smartphone. (5) Paddy stands by the arch, framing a shot on his phone while Peter watches intently. (6) A series of high-quality photos appear on screen showing Susan posing gracefully. (7) Paddy and Peter walk near a Ferris wheel; Paddy gestures towards the scenery while explaining something. (8) Screen recordings show the phone interface switching between 2x and 5x zoom, focusing on Susan and a small child on a carousel. (9) Paddy points at Peter's face while sitting on a park bench, demonstrating lighting. (10) Peter takes photos of Susan in a spinning teacup ride. (11) They sit together reviewing photos, smiling and giving thumbs up. (12) Paddy is shown in a professional studio setting talking to the camera. (13) Montage of travel, food, and commercial photos. (14) Peter speaks directly to the camera in an indoor room, holding his phone and looking enthusiastic with graphic overlays of prices and QR codes.
